category.quote: Funds will be allocated under annual Budget Estimates toward disbursement of Margin Money (subsidy) for setting up new micro-enterprises/units; and

age.quote: Any individual, above 18 years of age.

gate_notes: Assistance only for new projects sanctioned specifically under PMEGP; existing units and units that already availed Government Subsidy under any other scheme are not eligible.
Only one person from one family is eligible where family includes self and spouse.
For setting up of project costing above Rs.10 lakh in Manufacturing and above Rs 5,00,000 in Business/Service, minimum VIII standard pass educational qualification required.

Negative list of activities not permitted including meat, intoxicants, liquor outlets, tobacco, toddy, cultivation/plantation, sericulture, horticulture, animal husbandry except value addition/off-farm linked activities.
Upgradation of existing PMEGP/REGP/MUDRA units requires successful adjustment after 3-year lock-in, successful repayment of first loan, and profit-making unit with growth potential.
